Features and description

Located in the highly sought after Pepys Court development, with views of the river. This beautifully presented two bedroom ground floor apartment offers bright, modern living with the benefit of private outdoor space and allocated parking. Ideally positioned for easy access to Cambridge city centre, the Science Park, and the River Cam, this home is perfect for professionals, downsizers, or investors.

Key Features
Two spacious double bedrooms, each with fitted wardrobes

Master bedroom with contemporary ensuite shower room

Bright, open plan living and kitchen area with full height windows and doors opening onto the balcony

Private balcony with attractive views

Fully fitted modern kitchen with integrated appliances and generous storage

Stylish family bathroom suite and modern tiling

Allocated residents’ parking space

Ground floor position offering easy access throughout

Well kept communal grounds surrounding the building

Accommodation
The apartment opens into a welcoming hallway with built in storage. The openplan living/dining/kitchen area is a standout feature—exceptionally light, with large glazing that frames views of the field and provides direct access to the private balcony. The kitchen is finished to a high standard with woodeffect units, integrated appliances, and ample worktop space.

Both bedrooms are generous doubles, each benefitting from fitted wardrobes. The master bedroom further enjoys a modern ensuite shower room, while the main bathroom offers a clean, contemporary finish.

Outside
The private balcony provides a peaceful spot to relax and enjoy the views over the communal green space and river. The development itself is well maintained with landscaped gardens, and the property comes with a dedicated parking space.

Location
Pepys Court is well positioned for access to local shops, green spaces, and river walks, and offers excellent connections to Cambridge North Station, the Science & Business Parks, and major transport links.
